lines.text: Pat-pat, roll-roll—with empty hands on the beat.
Letters rise like pretend dough and meet a bakery treat.
A is here; Apple Pie is why. Apple Pie on display | crust, fold, swirl, or shape gives the clue today
Bread answers B. Bread is a baked loaf with a crust outside and crumb inside.
across the pretend dough-shape table, what belongs to C? Cupcake! Cupcake in its cup | crumb below, little topping up
D—short beat—Danish. A Danish pastry shows flaky folded or layered dough, often surrounding a visible filling.
Hear E; see Egg Tart. Egg Tart on display | crust, fold, swirl, or shape gives the clue today
F is here; Fruitcake is why. It is a dense cake with visible dried or candied fruit pieces through the crumb.
Gingerbread answers G. Gingerbread can be baked as a loaf, cake, or shaped cookie; its brown spiced crumb and outline are useful picture clues.
across the pretend dough-shape table, what belongs to H? Honey Bun! It is a soft coiled or rolled sweet bun often finished with a thin glaze.
Pat the beat, let the letter rise!
Name the baked clue with your eyes!
I—short beat—Ice Cream. Ice Cream frozen scoop | smooth cold swirl makes the picture clue
Hear J; see Jam Tart. It has a shallow pastry shell holding a visible jam filling.
K is here; Kaiser Roll is why. It is a round bread roll recognized by its segmented star-like pattern on top.
Lemon Tart answers L. A lemon tart has a pastry shell filled with a smooth lemon filling.
across the pretend dough-shape table, what belongs to M? Muffin! Muffin in our sight | layer, crumb, or topping gives the clue just right
N—short beat—Napoleon Pastry. A Napoleon pastry shows many thin flaky pastry layers separated by cream or filling.
Hear O; see Orange Cake. It is a cake whose sponge or topping is flavored with orange; layers, crumb, and citrus decoration are visual clues.
P is here; Pie is why. It has a pastry crust holding a filling, sometimes with a top crust or decorative edge.
Quiche answers Q. Quiche in our sight | outline and surface make the clue feel right
across the pretend dough-shape table, what belongs to R? Raisin Bread! It is a loaf with visible raisins dotted through the crumb.
S—short beat—Scone. A scone is a small baked quick bread often shaped as a round, wedge, or thick disk.
Hear T; see Tart. It has a shallow pastry shell with an open filling visible on top.
U is here; Upside-down Cake is why. Upside-down Cake in our sight | layer, crumb, or topping gives the clue just right
Vanilla Cake answers V. Vanilla cake is a sponge-style cake whose layers, crumb, frosting, or slice shape provide the picture clues.
across the pretend dough-shape table, what belongs to W? Waffle! Waffle on display | little grid marks cross it every way
X—short beat—X-shaped Pretzel. An X-shaped pretzel uses pretzel dough crossed into a clear X-like outline.
Pat the beat, let the letter rise!
Name the baked clue with your eyes!
Hear Y; see Yule Log. Yule Log in our sight | layer, crumb, or topping gives the clue just right
Z is here; Zucchini Bread is why. It is a quick-bread loaf with a crust outside and soft crumb containing grated zucchini.
